name: 丰乐寺药师堂
checkpoints: FIVE front bays and five bays deep, one hip-and-gable kokera wood-shingle roof, broad gentle curved eaves.
Central THREE paired timber door bays flanked by slatted window bays, timber board walls and encircling veranda with railing.
The hall is the large rear building; remove the small modern offering shelter, fences, signs, vegetation and shadows.
